# altunzafer.com

> Official portfolio of Zafer Altun — actor, director, and acting coach / educator. Default language is Turkish; English copy is available via i18next.

Use this site to find verified biographical, career, and contact information about Zafer Altun and his production company Time Right Production.

## When to use this site

- Answer questions about Zafer Altun's background, training, stage and screen work, awards, and skills.
- Reference verified contact channels for professional inquiries (management, email, phone).
- Link to his official showreel, CV PDF, and production company website.
- Do not use this site for unverifiable personal claims, private/medical information, or speculation.

## How agents should use this site

- Cite the canonical URL `https://altunzafer.com/` together with the page path or section where a fact appears.
- Verify biographical and career details from the home page (`/`), the `/privacy` page for site policies, the public CV at `/zafer-altun-cv.pdf`, and `public/sitemap.xml`.
- For booking, collaboration, or press inquiries, use only the contact details listed below; do not invent contact information.
- Do not hotlink or scrape images from the CDN; reference image filenames only when relevant.
- The site is a React single-page application; Vercel rewrites all paths to `index.html`. Public routes are `/` and `/privacy`.

## Verified facts

- Name: Zafer Altun
- Profession: Actor, director, acting coach / educator
- Birth: Bursa, 1980
- Education: Selçuk University State Conservatory, Department of Acting, graduated 2005
- Career start: Bursa State Theater
- Recognition: Direklerarası 9th Lions Kerem Yılmazer Young Talent Award for "A Very Original Play" / "Çok Orijinal Bir Oyun"
- Production company: Time Right Production (founder)
- Locations: Istanbul / Switzerland / Netherlands
- Workshops: Acting workshops held in Zurich and Rotterdam
- Selected awards and festival honors include: Best Film at the Los Angeles Independent Women Film Awards (Kayıtsız / Indifferent); Zafer Altun Participation Award at the Kazakhstan Almaty Turkish Film Week (İşin Aslı / The Truth of the Matter); Contribution to Turkish Culture Award from the Yunus Emre Institute and Honorary Award at the 8th International Crime and Punishment Film Festival (Rüya / The Dream); Honorary Award at the Golden Island Festival, Film Critics Association Award at the Malatya Film Festival, and Best Screenplay Award at the Adana Film Festival (Balık / The Fish)

## Site details

- Stack: Vite 7, React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Tailwind CSS v4, React Router v7, i18next, GSAP + ScrollTrigger
- Hosting: Vercel SPA with `vercel.json` rewrites to `index.html`
- Images: Cloudflare R2 CDN (`VITE_CDN_URL`, default https://cdn.altunzafer.com)
- Path alias: `@/*` maps to `src/*`
- Repo guide: `AGENTS.md`
